newsitem.title: USA: Miami airport sees 9.1 pct boost in int'l cargo.
newsitem.headline: Miami airport sees 9.1 pct boost in int'l cargo.

text.p: International freight volume at Miami International Airport in May jumped 9.1 percent to 129,040 tons from May 1996, Metro-Dade County Aviation Department said Wednesday.
Domestic cargo tonnage decreased 1.7 percent to 27,854 tons in May. Combined freight tonnage increased 7 percent to 156,894 tons.

International passenger traffic rose 6.7 percent in May to 1.18 million, while domestic passenger traffic increased 7.5 percent to 1.61 million. Combined passenger traffic rose 7.16 percent to 2.8 million.
Aircraft operations for the month rose 3.6 percent to 44,872 operations, an average of 1,447 operations per day.
